components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Brass action for the main research or download path.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:21px; min-height:47px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--brass); background:var(--brass); color:#171a1d; text-decoration:none; font:700 12px/1.5 var(--sans); transition:background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--brass-soft); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary span { color:var(--teal-dark); font-size:15px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Quiet secondary action with a teal directional cue.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; min-height:43px; padding:0 2px; color:var(--ink-soft); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); text-decoration:none; font:700 12px/1.5 var(--sans); transition:color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { color:var(--teal); border-color:var(--teal); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary span { color:var(--teal); }

components.name: Publication Navigation
components.description: Quiet top-level links with a fine brass active rule.
components.html: HomeExperimentsLearn
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav a { position:relative; display:grid; align-items:center; min-height:48px; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; font:500 11px/1.5 var(--sans); } .ds-nav a::after { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-1px; left:0; height:2px; background:var(--brass); content:''; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .18s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.ds-active { color:var(--ink); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a.ds-active::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: A measured result with a nearby limitation and evidence link.
components.html:
MEASURED FINDING · EXPERIMENT J

35–48% more tokens

Without a reliable correctness improvement in the tested tasks.

LIMITS · One repository and model; eight runs per task and arm.
components.css: .ds-evidence { padding:18px 20px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-soft); } .ds-evidence strong { display:block; margin:12px 0 5px; color:var(--ink); font:600 26px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing:-.045em; } .ds-evidence p { margin:0; font:400 13px/1.65 var(--sans); } .ds-evidence .ds-label { color:var(--teal); font:400 9px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-evidence .ds-limit { margin-top:12px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; }

components.name: Research Record
components.description: An open editorial row for a published or planned experiment.
components.html: ● PUBLISHEDJRepository optimisationFour changes and three structure questions↗
components.css: .ds-record { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 42px minmax(0,1fr) 20px; align-items:center; gap:15px; padding:16px 5px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; } .ds-record:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal) 4%, transparent); } .ds-status { color:var(--teal); font:400 8px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-id { color:var(--brass-soft); font:450 38px/1 var(--serif); } .ds-copy { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; } .ds-copy strong { font:640 13px/1.4 var(--sans); } .ds-copy small { color:var(--muted); font:400 10px/1.5 var(--sans); } .ds-arrow { color:var(--teal); } .ds-record:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Experiment Status
components.description: Compact publication state label; color communicates status, not a result.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brass) 42%, var(--line)); background:var(--surface); color:var(--brass-soft); font:400 9px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.075em; } .ds-chip i { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--brass); }

components.name: Feedback Loop Mark
components.description: Orbital symbol linking the site mark to the coding-agent feedback loop.
components.html: <svg class="ds-loop" viewBox="0 0 120 80" role="img" aria-label="A connected feedback loop"><ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="48" ry="20"/><ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="48" ry="20" transform="rotate(60 60 40)"/><circle cx="20" cy="34" r="3"/><circle cx="94" cy="49" r="3"/><circle cx="59" cy="18" r="3"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-loop { width:120px; fill:none; stroke:var(--line); stroke-width:1; } .ds-loop circle { fill:var(--teal); stroke:var(--bg); stroke-width:2; } .ds-loop circle:nth-of-type(2) { fill:var(--brass); } .ds-loop circle:nth-of-type(3) { fill:var(--brass); }

narrative.overview:
Programming the Loop presents coding-agent research with the calm precision of a field journal and the visual language of an engineering laboratory. Midnight navy and warm ivory establish the reading environment; brass carries editorial emphasis, while teal marks active systems, evidence links, and feedback paths. The orbital mark and loop diagram connect the site to the ebook's visual identity.

The composition is editorial rather than dashboard-like: generous headline scale, asymmetrical feature layouts, open data presentations, compact monospaced annotations, and fine rules that organize the page. Long-form lessons remain restrained and readable. Dark is the preferred appearance, with a coordinated paper-toned light theme.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial type carries the hierarchy; interface ornament stays quiet.
Research claims sit beside their conditions, limits, and evidence paths.
Orbital geometry represents task, context, code, verification, and feedback.
Brass marks editorial emphasis; teal marks active technical relationships.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies active technical information; brass identifies editorial emphasis. Keep both accents purposeful and distinct.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the sans family for interface and body copy. Reserve the serif for selected editorial titles and emphasis, not for dense data labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal surfaces to organize the page; reserve shadows for overlays and the book artwork.

dos: Do keep research conditions and limitations adjacent to measured claims.
Do use a maximum content width near 1,480px for wide editorial surfaces and a readable measure for lessons.
Do preserve the dark navy, warm ivory, brass, and teal roles across new pages.
Do use Newsreader selectively to create editorial emphasis within the Manrope hierarchy.
Do use thin rules, data labels, and orbital geometry to express research structure.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and keyboard focus visibility.
donts: Don't present experiment-specific observations as universal conclusions.
Don't add decorative charts or unsupported metrics.
Don't use generic blue-purple gradients, stock imagery, or repetitive dashboard-card grids.
Don't use glow and shadow as the default way to create hierarchy.
